Blockchain technology works like a shared digital record book that is not controlled by any single person or company. Instead of one central authority, many computers keep a copy of this book, which makes the system secure and open for everyone to see.

In this system, information is grouped into "blocks." Once a block is added to the chain, it cannot be changed or erased. This is because each block is mathematically linked to the one before it using complex codes. If someone tries to alter a past record, it would break the link and be immediately obvious to everyone. This makes the system very hard to hack or cheat.
